title: Alpha.99 is available
notes: Collect glowing Supply drops, shared in co-op, and follow clearer NPC missions. Improves save-reset recovery, Sporewing targeting and wings, Wicker movement, enemy scale, text editing, southern terrain and day/night transitions. Kill heat refunds now have a limit per attack; base boss health and Oathmarks are unchanged. Both co-op players should update to Alpha.99.
